newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F&N Coca-Cola in Pakistan joint venture.
newsitem.headline: F&N Coca-Cola in Pakistan joint venture.

text.p: F&N Coca-Cola Pte Ltd, a joint venture between drinks firms Fraser and Neave and the U.S. Coca-Cola Co, said on Wednesday it signed a joint venture agreement with a business group in Pakistan, Packages Ltd.

The company said in a statement F&N Coca-Cola's Pakistan unit, Coca-Cola Beverages Pakistan, would increase its share capital through a new share issue, giving the Pakistan investors a 20 percent interest in the joint venture.
It gave no other details of the share issue.
It said Coca-Cola Beverages Pakistan would continue to produce Coca-Cola Co products and expand its manufacturing facilities, sales and distribution network in Karachi.
